tables.name: source_scope
tables.requirements: Source credentials remain outside database rows.

tables.name: source_identity
tables.requirements: UNIQUE(provider,scope_ref,external_id); independent of content/revision.

tables.name: source_record
tables.requirements: FK source_id; SHA256 raw bytes; deletion retains prior identity/hash.

tables.name: configuration_revision
tables.requirements: UNIQUE(kind,id,version); no duplicated Git defaults.

tables.name: authority_record
tables.requirements: Authenticated principal/origin plus exact scope/evidence; external evidence cannot populate this registry.

tables.name: command_transaction
tables.ownership: Atomic authorized request and idempotent receipt
tables.requirements: UNIQUE committed_store_revision and audit_id; original request fingerprint retained.

tables.name: audit_entry
tables.requirements: UNIQUE request_id; deferred mutual FK with command_transaction.

tables.name: audit_change
tables.requirements: FK audit_entry; UNIQUE(audit_id,aggregate_kind,aggregate_id,after_revision).

tables.name: store_epoch
tables.requirements: CHECK singleton; positive revision; last transaction FK.

tables.name: task_identity
tables.requirements: No reuse/renumbering after historical outcomes.

tables.name: effort_observation
tables.requirements: FK task_id; typed observation meaning; actual increment distinct from cumulative report and estimate.

tables.name: task_revision
tables.ownership: Versioned canonical Task core and U snapshot
tables.requirements: FK task_identity,authority_record,audit_change; separate completion/disposition/requiredness, 1..5 task ratings; COMPLETE requires known U=0.

tables.name: task_head
tables.requirements: Composite FK task_revision(task_id,revision); CAS updates share transaction.

tables.name: stage_revision
tables.requirements: FK task_id/task_revision; not a second registered TaskType or added parent budget.

tables.name: candidate_revision
tables.requirements: FK source_record; accepted resolution needs scoped review authority; confidence is not authority.

tables.name: review_frame
tables.requirements: Source/time/queue binding; absence is not an empty queue.

tables.name: review_member
tables.requirements: FK review_frame; per-member revision/estimate identity.

tables.name: review_response
tables.requirements: FK review_frame; trusted user source; defaults/unsubmitted suggestions never authorize.

tables.name: estimate_verification
tables.requirements: FK observation/task/review; retain original observation time, separate verified_at and batch membership.

tables.name: relationship_rule_revision
tables.requirements: FK configuration_revision/authority; version is audit metadata, not new occurrence identity.

tables.name: generation_occurrence
tables.requirements: UNIQUE(rule_id,source_task_id,occurrence_key,target_role); rule version excluded; source creation and target typed linkage.

tables.name: task_relation_revision
tables.requirements: Separate generation graph; stage endpoints bind explicit parent, current versions checked transactionally.

tables.name: expiration_notice
tables.requirements: UNIQUE(task_id,task_revision,condition_ref); detection is not delivery/expiry.

tables.name: dispatch_attempt
tables.requirements: FK notice; correlation/content/channel scope; ambiguity requires original reconciliation.

tables.name: dispatch_result
tables.requirements: FK original attempt; confirmed delivery needs delivered_at; UNKNOWN/FAILED cannot claim delivery time.

tables.name: goal_revision
tables.ownership: Accepted/draft Goal setup independent of Task workload
tables.requirements: Typed target/progress measure/time/cadence; no duplicate Task remaining-work column.

tables.name: goal_progress
tables.requirements: FK exact Goal revision; attaining target does not infer completion.

tables.name: milestone_revision
tables.requirements: FK exact Goal revision; no duplicate parent effort.

tables.name: exam_revision
tables.requirements: Date-only exam is not 23:59 deadline or fabricated occupied interval.

tables.name: calendar_event_revision
tables.ownership: Scoped source event and occupancy classification
tables.requirements: FK source_record/scope; external fixed vs owned planned work; explicit timing/occupancy; source revisions retained.

tables.name: normalized_due
tables.ownership: Immutable source time and normalization policy
tables.requirements: FK source_record; preserve original timestamp/offset; DATE_ONLY policy records Beijing 23:59.

tables.name: today_lock
tables.requirements: FK Task revision/authority; intent COMPLETE or ADVANCE does not assert actual completion.

tables.name: planning_snapshot
tables.requirements: FK store epoch/committed transaction reference and configuration metadata; gaps stay explicit.

tables.name: forecast_horizon
tables.requirements: Typed C/R/S/risk/proof quality; unknown values nullable; horizons overlap and never summed.

tables.name: plan_record
tables.requirements: FK planning_snapshot; final emergency requires committed review/recompute references.

tables.name: plan_allocation
tables.requirements: FK plan/task revision; positive exact rational seconds; stage references part of parent budget.

tables.name: model_revision
tables.requirements: No behavioral configuration writes; applicability resolved independently from external output.

tables.name: ai_job_revision
tables.requirements: Context hash/snapshot/output contract/executor class retained; no secrets/raw context.

tables.name: ai_result
tables.ownership: Immutable external output and usage provenance
tables.requirements: FK exact job revision; content hash and unknown/exact usage; never effective authority.

tables.name: ai_import_record
tables.requirements: FK source job/result/hash; identical replay no effect, changed same-ID content conflicts.

tables.name: numeric_eligibility
tables.requirements: Exact Task/model/context/snapshot and validated model lifecycle binding; row is not user authority.

tables.name: remaining_prediction
tables.requirements: FK model/version,Task revision,job/result/eligibility; no U rewrite; not original-total effort.

tables.name: behavior_candidate
tables.requirements: FK job/result/target revision; no self-acceptance; reviewed adoption separate.

tables.name: outbox_entry
tables.requirements: FK command_transaction/audit; UNIQUE(idempotency_key); pending entry is not delivered evidence.

tables.name: collector_checkpoint
tables.requirements: FK source_scope; cursor advance and captured history share transaction.

tables.name: schema_migration
tables.requirements: Immutable checksum/version; failed migration cannot be recorded applied.

tables.name: model_lifecycle_event
tables.requirements: Model version remains immutable; current applicability is revalidated in the application transaction.

tables.name: ai_job_event
tables.requirements: Context revision is distinct from execution status; no alteration of export scope.

tables.name: source_lifecycle_event
tables.requirements: Tombstone never cancels or completes canonical tasks; captured source identity is retained.

tables.name: task_details_revision
tables.ownership: Version-bound generic Task times, original estimate and session facts; no U/B/actual replacement

tables.name: task_field_provenance
tables.ownership: Immutable version-bound field evidence; unresolved source references cannot authorize canonical mutation

transaction_checks: Authenticate caller and independently resolve exact current domain authority; input flags/schema confidence are not grants.
Lock/version-check store epoch, targets, source/config/rule/model/notice references inside one transaction.
Reject same request ID with changed fingerprint; return original receipt for exact authorized historical retry.
Insert canonical revisions, full before/after audit, receipt, occurrence and outbox/checkpoint effects atomically.
Revalidate successful notice delivery and latest Task/condition before EXPIRED; preserve INCOMPLETE/U/history.
Reject worked/missing/stale members as a whole unchanged batch; never silently narrow exact confirmation.
Preserve one parent effective B; stage shares are derived and distinct obligations alone add workload.
Never treat NULL/UNKNOWN/stale/gapped sources as verified zero, empty complete data or successful delivery.
Raw source/observation/result/audit records are append-only; enforce via owner separation/privileges/triggers and tests.
On transient rollback retry a bounded exact request; on unknown commit/delivery reconcile original identity first.
outstanding: Validate draft DDL/constraints/triggers/migration rollback using an actual selected isolated PostgreSQL runtime; static checks do not execute SQL.
Freeze complete contracts/transport/runtime; implement transactional authority, codecs and StateStore adapters.
Verify concurrency, crash/reconciliation, backup/restore and owner-separated runtime grants before activation.
Retain deferred real profiles/source scopes/capacity as unknown; no real activation from this design.
